input.question: 在 mf_netvalueperformancehis 表中按基金简称(SecuAbbr)和两年年化收益率(AnnualizedRRInTwoYear)排名，找出收益率最高的10只基金和最低的5只基金

tool_log.name: nl2sql
tool_log.content:
生成的 SQL:
```sql
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    SecuAbbr,
    AnnualizedRRInTwoYear,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AnnualizedRRInTwoYear DESC) AS rank_desc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AnnualizedRRInTwoYear ASC)  AS rank_asc
  FROM mf_netvalueperformancehis
  WHERE AnnualizedRRInTwoYear IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT SecuAbbr, AnnualizedRRInTwoYear,
       CASE WHEN rank_desc <= 10 THEN 'top10'
            WHEN rank_asc <= 5  THEN 'bottom5'
       END AS category
FROM ranked
WHERE rank_desc <= 10 OR rank_asc <= 5
ORDER BY category, AnnualizedRRInTwoYear DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
